title: Le Futur Simple vs Le Conditionnel Présent

items.translation: Futur: -rai (what will happen). Conditionnel: -rais (what would happen)
items.exampleFr: Demain je viendrai. Si je pouvais, je viendrais.
items.exampleEn: Tomorrow I will come. If I could, I would come.

items.exampleFr: Si tu viens, nous mangerons ensemble.
items.exampleEn: If you come, we will eat together.

items.exampleFr: Si tu venais, nous mangerions ensemble.
items.exampleEn: If you came, we would eat together.

items.prompt: Je ___ bien un café, s'il vous plaît.
À ta place, je ___ la vérité.
Si c'était possible, ils ___ plus tôt.
S'il fait beau demain, nous ___ au parc.
items.translation: If the weather is nice tomorrow, we will go to the park.

items.prompt: Si j'étais riche, j'___ une maison.
items.translation: If I were rich, I would buy a house.

items.prompt: Je ___ parler au directeur, s'il vous plaît.
items.translation: I would like to speak to the manager, please.
In ten years, everything will be different.
If she worked more, she would succeed.
Could you help me? That would be kind.

items.prompt: Si tu as faim, je te ___ un sandwich.
items.translation: If you are hungry, I will make you a sandwich.

items.prompt: Sans toi, je ne ___ pas quoi faire.
items.translation: Without you, I would not know what to do.

items.prompt: In French: “I would come if I could.”
